meta.title: Specialized Invoice Types (Freight, CHA): refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Open or use Specialized Invoice Types for Freight and CHA and verify its specialized invoice field sets
Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify the action is refused or absent
Repeat the check as an AP Executive and compare access on the same Enterprise tenant
Verify or establish that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or use Specialized Invoice Types for Freight and CHA and verify its specialized invoice field sets; Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify the action is refused or absent; Repeat the check as an AP Executive and compare access on the same Enterprise tenant; Verify or establish that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan

args.need: sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and as an AP Executive on the same Enterprise tenant, open Specialized Invoice Types for Freight and CHA, verify the non-AP Executive user is refused or does not see it, then verify the AP Executive can use it and record the available Freight and CHA field sets

steps.note: The required invoice workflow and role-specific access comparison are not represented by any catalog step.
Provides a final assertion after the tester interaction without claiming that the unavailable invoice subject was covered.
